title: Biomarker
description: A Cat-VRS CategoricalVariant. Root type `Biomarker` with one subtype per `biomarker_type` extension value; `GeneFusion` further specializes `Rearrangement`.

Biomarker.description: Root type shared by every biomarker. Subtypes below are selected by the `biomarker_type` extension; the top-level schema closes the record.

Somatic Variant.description: Somatic variant in a single gene.

Germline Variant.description: Germline variant in a single gene.

Rearrangement.description: Chromosomal rearrangement. `GeneFusion` further specializes it when `rearrangement_type` is Fusion.

Wild type.description: Absence of variants in a gene.

Gene Fusion.description: Gene fusion: a Rearrangement with `rearrangement_type` = Fusion and one or two partner genes. When the biomarker type is renamed to "Gene fusion", change the discriminator in this file's top-level `allOf` and add `Gene fusion` to the `biomarker_type` values.
